notes.title: Version 1.1 is live - new movement option
notes.notes:
I've added a new option for moving around the Chunky Orbits sim. It's very similar to classic first person shooter controls. You can move with the left touchpad or thumbstick, and rotate with the right. Modify your direction by pointing your left hand. Press in on the pad/stick to move faster.

I still like the funky 'accordion' style movement from previous versions, but several users have requested something a little more familiar.  You can use either method, they are both available at all times. 

Other changes include some small adjustments to the main menu and an update to Unity engine v 5.6. See the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/535190/discussions/2/341537388318898707/]ChangeLog[/url] for the full list. 

Thanks to everyone who's supporting my indie dev efforts by buying my stuff! Please let me know if I broke anything. ːcsdsmileː

notes.title: Chunky Orbits is now Ambidextrous
notes.notes:
The beta7 build is now live and lets you use both hands to create, delete, and grab the chunks. Full list of changes:

[list]
[*] You can now create, delete, and grab chunks with both hands.  
[*] Option to turn the  background music on and off

Just a little more polish and a few more tweaks until Chunky Orbits is out of Early Access and on to full release.

notes.title: Beta 6 now available - Touch models and better help text
notes.notes:
Howdy folks. I posted a new version of Chunky Orbits to go along with some new features in SteamVR. There are now Oculus Touch models for Rift users, along with a slightly different setup for the button mappings. 

[list]
[*] Support for Oculus touch models. If you're using Touch you should now see a proper representation of the controllers. Vive users should see their Vive wands.
[*] Refined the help text. Easier to read, more specific info, and proper positons for Touch/Vive. Please let me know if any of these help text objects seem out of position.
[*] White Dwarf now behaves like the other chunks - hold trigger to create, release to set it free.
[*] Center Stone no longer locks in place. It does have some 'drag' added to the physics sim to keep it from moving freely. White Dwarf has this drag as well. I think it's nice to be able to set up some orbits with these (mostly) stationary objects.
[*] New 'cursor' object visible when selecting menu items. Easier to tell exactly where to 'poke' to select items.
[*] Absorber chunks are now take on a random color when created.
[*] I got rid of the transparent 'currently selected tool' icons. They were reduntant since the same info is on the help text screens. They also cluttered up the view.
[/list]

I'm happy with the progress I've made and I'm nearly ready for the full release of Chunky Orbits. Just a few more tweaks/refinements and she'll be ready to go.

notes.title: Touch controller models in SteamVR
notes.notes:
The [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/250820/announcements/detail/289751074098334493]latest SteamVR Beta[/url] has added Oculus Touch controller models. So now people with Touch will see the proper controller when using SteamVR. I'll be adding support for this in Chunky Orbits soon. Until then, things will look a little funny if you are on the SteamVR Beta and using Touch.

The default button mappings have also changed in the beta. Menu buttons are now B and Y, and the System button is now the Left Oculus button.  These new mappings should make their way to the normal SteamVR client soon. You might temporarily see some incorrect button labels depending on which version of the client you are running.

notes.title: New Chaos Mode
notes.notes:
I've posted another update to Chunky Orbits that includes a new reboot option called [b]Chaos[/b]. This spawns a collection of random objects in random positions with random velocities. This is a great way to stir things up and discover interesting configurations that you might not think to create yourself.

Full list of changes:
[list]
[*] New reboot option: Chaos 
[*] New objects on Reboot are placed in front of the player instead of in the center of the playspace. Look down if you want the new chunks to spawn below you, look up if you want them above.
[*] Particle effect when a White Dwarf consumes a chunk
[*] Move the pinch and pull direction indicator back to the centerpoint between your hands. Fixed jittery motion of the indicator, too.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta 4 ready for action
notes.notes:
Howdy. I've just posted a new version of Chunky Orbits and a dev diary video.
https://youtu.be/efaOQrsaQZU
What's new:
[list]
[*] Molten Chunk. A destructive projectile with fancy-schmancy particles.

[*] Fixed a case where chunks would get stranded in space and not included in the gravity calculations.
[/list]
Just a couple more weeks of working on the sim. If you have a suggestions or feedback now is a good time to send 'em my way.

notes.title: Early Access beta3 - new menu system
notes.notes:
New version of Chunky Orbits is posted and ready for your gravitic ponderings. I'm testing out a different menu system that takes better advantage of tracked hands and VR. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26442346/35199a878ce0a2280aa75c800b9d34a0d7f23e66.jpg[/img]

Press the Menu button on either Vive wand to open and close a menu of 3D icons. Poke at them with your controller to select 'em. Left hand brings up the ReBoot universe menu, right hand brings up the list of Chunks that you can add to your Universe. Rift+Touch users can use the A and X buttons.

The old Analog stick based menu system is still in place. I may keep both. The new menu needs tweaking, but it seems like a much better fit.

notes.title: Small update with better performance
notes.notes:
I posted a small update to Chunky orbits tonight. 
[list]
[*]Improved performance. I optimized the main game loop that caclulates the gravitational forces. It's now twice as fast and more consistant across all rendered frames. Should provide a smoother experience and allow you to add more rocks to the scene before performace decreases. On my system I can get nearly 300 chunks going before I start to see frame drops. 
[*]Fixed the texture on the Vive wand on the title screen. Wrong button was highlighted. ːsteamfacepalmː
[*]New Universe starts with 100 rocks instead of 42. Soon you'll be able to choose what to spawn when you reboot your Universe. 
[/list]

That's all for now. Bigger update coming on Monday, the 31st.

notes.title: Chunky Orbits Beta1 - tracked controller support
notes.notes:
Howdy folks. I've posted the Early Access Beta1 version of Chunky Orbits - the beginnings of tracked controller support. Should work with your Vive wands or Oculus Touch.

I'm experimenting with a new way to move around the space, something I'm calling 'Pinch and Pull'. It's a little weird, but it works well and seems to reduce that feeling of motion sickness that some people feel in VR.

To move around:
[list]
[*]Press both of the Grip buttons - one on each hand.
[*]Pull your hands apart to move forward.
[*]Pinch your hands together to move backward.
[*]Release the Grip buttons to stop.
[/list]

The direction you move is controlled by pointing your hands. While holding the grip buttons you'll see a Green Arrow. That arrow shows the current front/back direction. When you move your hands farther apart or closer together you'll follow the direction of that arrow. 

Much harder to describe than it is to use. ːcsdsmileː I'll make a short demo video soon.

The gamepad version of the sim is still available. Just press A on your gamepad during the title screen to launch that version.  Touch users will see the Vive wands in their gameview for now. I'll have the proper Touch models in there soon. 

Head on over to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/535190/discussions/3/343788552547833925/]Beta Builds forum[/url] to leave feedback, offer suggestions, or get some help.
